foundations.name: UNICEF
foundations.description: Protecting the rights and wellbeing of every child, everywhere.
foundations.longDescription: UNICEF works in more than 190 countries and territories to help children survive, thrive, and fulfill their potential. From emergency response to education and health, their mission is rooted in dignity and hope for the next generation.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Contributions support emergency relief, vaccines, education, clean water, and child protection programs worldwide.
foundations.transparency: UNICEF publishes annual reports and audited financial statements on its official website.
recentUpdates: Expanding emergency response for children affected by conflict and climate disasters.
Continuing global immunization and nutrition programs.

foundations.name: Médecins Sans Frontières
foundations.description: Independent medical humanitarian care for people in crisis.
foundations.longDescription: Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) delivers emergency medical aid to people affected by conflict, epidemics, disasters, or exclusion from healthcare. Their work is guided by medical ethics and the principles of neutrality and independence.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Funds support field hospitals, medical staff, medicines, and emergency response operations.
foundations.transparency: MSF shares detailed operational and financial reports through its national associations.
recentUpdates: Responding to medical emergencies in conflict and disaster zones.
Continuing independent care where needs are greatest.

foundations.name: World Food Programme
foundations.description: Delivering food assistance to people facing hunger worldwide.
foundations.longDescription: The World Food Programme is the world's largest humanitarian organization addressing hunger and promoting food security. In emergencies and beyond, WFP works to save lives and strengthen resilience for communities in need.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Support goes toward emergency food assistance, nutrition programs, and logistics that deliver aid where it is needed most.
foundations.transparency: WFP publishes public reports on operations, funding, and results.
recentUpdates: Scaling food assistance for communities facing acute hunger.
Strengthening supply chains for humanitarian delivery.

foundations.name: UNHCR
foundations.description: Protecting refugees and people forced to flee their homes.
foundations.longDescription: UNHCR, the UN Refugee Agency, safeguards the rights and wellbeing of refugees, forcibly displaced communities, and stateless people. Their work offers protection, shelter, and pathways toward dignity and belonging.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Donations help provide shelter, protection, emergency aid, and long-term support for displaced families.
foundations.transparency: UNHCR publishes global reports and financial disclosures on its official channels.
recentUpdates: Supporting people forced to flee conflict and persecution.

foundations.name: WWF
foundations.description: Conserving nature and reducing the most pressing threats to Earth.
foundations.longDescription: WWF works to protect biodiversity, restore ecosystems, and help humanity live in harmony with nature. From forests and oceans to climate action, their efforts connect local communities with a shared global responsibility.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Funds support conservation projects, wildlife protection, and community-led environmental solutions.
foundations.transparency: WWF network organizations publish annual impact and financial reports.
recentUpdates: Advancing habitat protection and climate resilience.
Supporting communities that steward natural landscapes.

foundations.name: Save the Children
foundations.description: Giving children a healthy start, education, and protection from harm.
foundations.longDescription: Save the Children works around the world to ensure every child has the chance to grow up healthy, educated, and safe. In emergencies and everyday life, they stand with children and families facing hardship.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Support helps deliver education, healthcare, protection, and emergency relief for children.
foundations.transparency: Member organizations publish annual reports detailing impact and spending.
recentUpdates: Responding to crises that put children at risk.

foundations.name: International Rescue Committee
foundations.description: Helping people whose lives are shattered by conflict and disaster.
foundations.longDescription: The International Rescue Committee responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises and helps people survive, recover, and rebuild. Their work spans emergency aid, health, education, and economic recovery.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Donations fund emergency response, health services, education, and long-term recovery programs.
foundations.transparency: IRC publishes impact reports and audited financial information publicly.

foundations.name: Mental Health Foundation
foundations.description: Promoting good mental health for all and reducing stigma with care.
foundations.longDescription: The Mental Health Foundation works to help people understand, protect, and sustain their mental health. Through research, education, and community programs, they support wellbeing with dignity and compassion.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Funds support research, public education, and programs that help people care for their mental health.
foundations.transparency: Charity financial statements and impact reporting are available through official channels.
recentUpdates: Expanding public education on mental wellbeing.
